# A copy of delvera-hq/org-standards

Public repos can't use the private `delvera-hq/org-standards` action, so the template puts this copy here and CI runs
the name check from it. It's names.yaml version 1.6.0. Don't edit it: `copier update` replaces it with each
template release, and a name added to org-standards reaches public repos then.
